recommendation: Implement clinical management and education for diabetes patients
implementation_steps: Monitor clinical parameters (e.g., A1C, blood pressure) at regular intervals
Provide lifestyle counseling on diet, exercise, and stress management
Coordinate care across multiple providers and settings
Adjust medications under protocol based on patient response
evidence_summary: Nurse-led diabetes management interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in glycemic control, self-care behaviors, and quality of life across multiple randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews.
citation: Care Management for Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: The Roles of Nurses, Pharmacists, and Social Workers
